summary: Party of three descending Mt. Eolus; two lost footing on a steep snowfield below the summit on the west side of the Catwalk and slid 30-50 ft into a rock field. One man sustained a serious lower leg injury, another was also injured; the party activated a SPOT emergency signal. La Plata County SAR technical rescue team reached them and a helicopter lifted the seriously injured climber at ~5:10 p.m. to a waiting ambulance at Rockwood, then to Mercy Medical Center.
responding_agency: La Plata County Search and Rescue
